title: Generating Property-Based Regression Tests from Source Code Semantics
abstract: arXiv:2611.32636v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional unit tests (CUTs) check a method under test at fixed concrete inputs. A test can therefore miss a regression if its input produces the expected output despite a fault. Property-based testing (PBT) checks universally quantified specifications across many randomly generated inputs, but writing properties and input generators by hand is difficult. Existing approaches automate PBT creation by generalizing an existing or generated unit test suite. They either over-approximate concrete inputs across repetitive tests or apply single-path symbolic analysis along concrete test runs. This paper presents an approach that derives property-based regression tests directly from source code semantics via multipath symbolic execution (SE). For each explored path through a target method, the approach records a path semantics comprising the path condition, the symbolic return value, and the state change map. Each path semantics induces a Hoare

translated_title: 从源代码语义生成基于属性的回归测试
translated_abstract: 传统的单元测试（CUTs）在固定的具体输入下检查被测方法。因此，即使存在缺陷，如果测试输入仍然产生预期输出，测试就可能漏检回归错误。基于属性的测试（PBT）在大量随机生成的输入上检查全称量化的规范，但手动编写属性和输入生成器非常困难。现有的自动化PBT创建方法是通过泛化现有的或已生成的单元测试套件来实现的。它们要么在重复测试中对具体输入进行过度近似，要么沿具体测试运行应用单路径符号分析。本文提出了一种方法，通过多路径符号执行（SE）直接从源代码语义推导出基于属性的回归测试。对于目标方法中探索到的每条路径，该方法记录一条路径语义，包括路径条件、符号返回值和状态变化映射。每条路径语义都会导出一个Hoare……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出通过多路径符号执行直接从源代码语义自动推导基于属性的回归测试，克服了传统单元测试可能漏检回归错误以及手动编写属性和输入生成器困难的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an approach that derives property-based regression tests directly from source code semantics via multipath symbolic execution, addressing the limitations of conventional unit tests that can miss regressions and the difficulty of manually writing properties and input generators.
